final: WITH grouped AS (SELECT powerstatus, COUNT(*) AS n FROM telescopes GROUP BY powerstatus), ratios AS (SELECT powerstatus, n, 1.0 * n / SUM(n) OVER () AS share FROM grouped), avg_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS mean_share FROM ratios), kept AS (SELECT n, share, share - mean_share AS excess FROM ratios CROSS JOIN avg_share WHERE share > mean_share) SELECT SUM(n), AVG(share), AVG(excess) FROM kept
